app.name: OverviewDashboard
app.description: Explore request traffic from RUM applications through services to infrastructure

scopes.name: storage:buckets:read
scopes.comment: Required for every Grail query - without it queries succeed but return zero records

scopes.name: storage:spans:read
scopes.comment: Read distributed trace spans for service relationships

scopes.name: storage:smartscape:read
scopes.comment: Resolve service, application, and infrastructure entity names

scopes.name: storage:entities:read
scopes.comment: Read dt.entity.application, service, and host records

scopes.name: storage:metrics:read
scopes.comment: Read RUM, service, and host metrics

scopes.name: storage:events:read
scopes.comment: Read dt.davis.problems for the problem count tile

scopes.name: storage:user.events:read
scopes.comment: Read user.events to correlate RUM traces with backend services

scopes.name: davis:analyzers:execute
scopes.comment: Run the Davis forecast analyzer for the selected node's headline metric

scopes.name: storage:filter-segments:read
scopes.comment: List and apply segments in the topology map's segment selector
